categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies shared stream I/O infrastructure in `src/streams.h` (`BufferedWriter`) to prevent throwing destructors and ensure safe error handling.
categories.rationale: Fixes a primitive safety hazard in `BufferedWriter` where unflushed write failures triggered `std::terminate` during destruction or exception unwinding. Providing explicit `flush()` and `discard()` methods prevents crashes across callers using buffered streams.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Updates block and undo storage write handling in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Replaces abrupt `std::terminate` crashes on disk-full or write failure during block and undo writes with graceful shutdown and diagnostic logging. As noted by reviewers and the author, failed writes in `blockstorage.cpp` were causing unhandled exceptions rather than clean fatal shutdowns.
